Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW landscape game environment, exact 16:9 composition, request native 2560x1440 pixels or higher, at least FULL HD 1920x1080 detail. Not a screenshot. Inspired by Van Thanh flower village in Da Lat Vietnam: a beautifully kept outdoor highland flower garden, rows of white daisies, vibrant blue and pink hydrangeas, red roses and yellow flowers, a small timber garden arbor to the back left, distant terraced greenhouses and pine-covered hills under a clear light blue sky. Premium cozy fantasy adventure game background that will host colorful upright chibi wizard/traveler sprites. Crisp clean contours and finely painted natural textures, richly detailed individual flower heads, leaves and stone grains, warm vivid clear colors with realistic perspective and gentle dimensional shading, NO blur, NO washed-out veil, NO depth-of-field blur, NO pixel art. Midmorning sunlight from UPPER RIGHT, cool mountain freshness.
Composition: eye-level wide establishing view with a gently downward view of the ground, horizon at 39% height. A broad gently curved stone garden walkway comes toward the viewer, with THREE clearly usable small open standing areas connected to the path around x=27%,50%,76% y=83% (feet), no raised platforms or markers. Flower beds frame those areas and recede naturally, do not put seats or tables there. Viewpoint permits full-body standing figures about 22% of frame height to look grounded. Keep upper corners lightly framed by garden tree foliage, flowers low at far bottom corners only, preserve the middle lower path for figures. Environment only: NO characters, people, animals, silhouettes, UI, text, signs, lettering, arrows, logos, watermark. Not a café, not an indoor floor, not a stage, no chairs or foreground dining furniture. This is a living botanical garden setting, not a giant empty plaza. Match three-quarter storybook RPG sprite aesthetics with highly legible sharp detail across foreground and background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW extremely crisp outdoor adventure game environment inspired by Cau Dat tea hills in Da Lat Vietnam. Exact wide 16:9 landscape composition, request native 2560x1440 or higher, FULL HD detail across the entire frame. Rolling bright green tea terraces sweep in rhythmic gently curved rows down a highland valley, individual tea leaves readable in the near bushes. Distant dark pine ridges, a few tiny glasshouses on far slopes, vivid clear blue sky with a few luminous white cloud puffs. A natural light tan compacted-earth and small-stone walking trail widens at the near hilltop in the lower third; two comfortable standing spots connected by the same trail at x=34%,68%, feet y=84%. Trail leads diagonally into the tea fields to the upper right. No unrealistic empty concrete plaza. Low tea bushes and subtle golden wildflowers at the left and right foreground edges, a pine branch framing ONLY the top left corner. A small rough stone trail marker with NO writing at far edge, no furniture or buildings in foreground. Camera at human eye height slightly looking down, horizon around 36% height; standing chibi adventurer sprites about 23% of frame height can stand naturally on the foreground path. Refined premium cozy storybook fantasy RPG environment, clear contours, richly painted granular soil, stone and foliage textures, elegant dimensional shading, vibrant natural colors, no pixel art. Midmorning upper-right sunlight, consistent light direction. NO people, characters, animals, vehicles, UI, text, lettering, logos, arrows, watermark. NO cafe, chairs, tables, blurry fog, blur or washed-out bloom. Detailed high definition landscape with sharply defined tea terraces.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW exceptionally crisp highly detailed adventure game environment inspired by Tuyen Lam lake in Da Lat Vietnam. Exact 16:9 wide landscape composition. Request native 2560x1440 or higher, FULL HD detail. A serene blue-green mountain lake reflecting dense deep green pine forests and a layered mountain skyline, bright clear blue sky with fine small white clouds. A broad gently curved timber boardwalk and natural shore viewing area in the lower third, lightly worn honey-brown wood planks with distinct grain, a short low timber rail behind the usable walking surface, gravel and ferns at the left shore. The far end of the boardwalk gently curves into a pine trail at back left, distant tiny moored rowboat near the far bank only. One open standing spot on the near boardwalk centered x=60%, feet y=84% for a full-body chibi traveler about 25% of image height, visibly safely on solid ground, in FRONT of any rail and far from the water edge. A cluster of blue and violet hydrangeas and ferns confined to bottom left and bottom right corners; a few pine boughs at upper corners, not covering the lake view. No huge empty rectangular deck, organic shoreline composition. Eye-level camera with gentle downward ground view, horizon at 38% height. Premium cozy fantasy RPG/storybook game background with refined clean contours and richly painted natural textures, individual needles, detailed lake ripple reflections and realistic wood grain, very sharp edges without halos, warm midmorning sunlight from UPPER RIGHT. NO characters, humans, animals, silhouettes, UI, signs, writing, text, arrows, logos or watermark. NO cafe, foreground dining furniture, chairs, mist veil, depth-of-field blur, pixel art. A serene real-landscape-inspired magical woodland setting suitable for a standing violet-robed alien traveler.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is this lake environment. REMOVE THE SINGLE ALIEN PERSON in the foreground center completely. Remove all parts of the person, ears, antennae, backpack, clothing and its cast shadow. Reconstruct continuous matching wooden planks, wood grain and sunlight on the floor underneath, and the low wooden railing and lake reflections behind. Output an entirely EMPTY landscape environment with ZERO PEOPLE OR CREATURES. Preserve the original exact composition, dimensions, camera, all pine trees, mountains, sky, lake water, shore, flowers and boardwalk. Do not add any replacement subject, characters, animals, signs, writing, lettering, UI, marks, logos or watermark. Very crisp fine detail, same natural midmorning light from upper right.

Keep the exact same camera, field of view, crop boundaries, object positions, sizes, silhouettes, paths, terrain, branches, flowers and colors. Do NOT zoom, pan, add objects or remove objects. Only reconstruct finer high-frequency visual detail: individual hydrangea petals and daisy centers, rose folds, tiny leaf veins, fine wood grain and stone texture. Keep the original refined storybook RPG painting style, natural upper-right sunlight, no over-sharpened halos. Every large shape must stay precisely registered to this tile's coordinates for seamless assembly with an overlapping neighboring tile. No people, characters, faces, animals, writing, UI, symbols or watermark. Opaque full image, same near-square aspect ratio.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit target is this exact 16:9 flower garden. Make one registered STATIC GROUND / MIDDLE-GROUND alpha plate for a layered game scene. Keep exactly the original stone walkway, fixed garden arbor, all middle-distance flower beds and stone borders, fixed tree trunks at the far edges. REMOVE the blue sky, distant hills, far greenhouses, valley and background landscape to TRUE TRANSPARENCY. Also REMOVE only the nearest big flower clusters in the bottom left and bottom right corners BELOW 78% height and the overhanging leaves/branches within the TOP 25% of the picture; reconstruct matching clean stone path/soil underneath removed bottom clusters so they can move as separate foreground sprites. Keep the middle ground gardens unchanged, reconstruct any hidden path pixels. Keep the original exact 16:9 canvas and positions, do not crop, center, zoom, move or redesign anything. The complete walkable stone path must remain opaque across the lower center; original perspective, upper-right sun shadows, colors and sharp detail. Real RGBA alpha only outside these retained objects. No checkerboard pattern, colored matte, text, people, creatures, objects or UI added. Return ONLY this same-position static ground plate on a transparent background.

Use case: background-extraction. Everything else must be TRUE transparent RGBA: remove sky, distant hills, greenhouses, garden arbor, middle flower beds, ALL stone path and ground, rocks and tree trunks. Do not add any objects, people, characters, lettering or UI. No ground shadows, no checkerboard pixels, no colored backdrop. Real transparency.
